q: Do we need last year's figures in our first BRSR value chain disclosure?
title: First-year BRSR value chain disclosure
short: No. In the first year of value chain reporting, previous year figures are voluntary. For FY 2025-26 value chain disclosures, FY 2024-25 data is optional. But you must state what share of your purchases and sales the reported partners cover.
audience: Listed company ESG teams starting value chain reporting

ul: For the first year of value chain reporting, previous year numbers are voluntary. SEBI's own example: for FY 2025-26 disclosures, FY 2024-25 data is voluntary.
If you provide value chain disclosures, you must disclose the percentage of total purchases and sales covered by the partners included.

p: Value chain partners are upstream and downstream partners that individually make up 2% or more of purchases or sales by value. You may stop once covered partners reach 75% of purchases and sales. Reporting is voluntary for the top 250 listed companies from FY 2025-26.

ol: List partners at 2% or more of purchases and of sales.
Ask each for Scope 1 and 2, energy, water and waste attributable to your business with them.
Report what you receive, with coverage percentages, and mark estimates.
Ask for prior year data only where it is easy, since it is optional.

senseible: Senseible turns a supplier's electricity bills and fuel invoices into Scope 1 and 2 figures for the financial year, with each bill linked to its line, so a customer's questionnaire can be answered from records. Figures are self-declared.
